shots.seen: Cold dark room reads clearly: moon window with stars, red 3:07, tilted frames, bed with two sleepers and warm door strip. The bottom 40 percent of the frame is empty black floor and the caption bar floats on nothing.
problems: bottom of frame is dead black
shots.fix: Pull the camera down and zoom so the bed sits near frame centre and the plank floor with a moon-lit rug fills the lower third; add rim light on the bed edge.

shots.seen: Door with claw scratches, red handprint, warm strip and two foot shadows with a small doll. The door face is flat dark and the bottom third is black.
problems: door top and bottom corners empty
few crisp edges on the door
shots.fix: Add door panel mouldings, a hinge set, a brass knob and skirting board, and light the floor planks in the strip spill so lines show in the lower third.

shots.seen: Pale child face with hands gripping the blanket, lit from the right. Blanket quilting is visible but the upper corners and the bottom third are black.
shots.fix: Zoom further into the face and move it lower in frame, add a window-light shaft and wallpaper pattern behind the headboard so top cells carry detail.
